method: Paired observer windows bracket SELECT, not pure query-only measurement. PSI some total delta is Linux VM task-stall wall fraction, not CPU utilization. Three points/group, no p95, no regression significance or causal attribution.
activityLimitation: Observer held a read-only transaction without pg_stat_clear_snapshot; queryStartedUTC reused per cohort. Raw snapshots retained in synchronized-measurements.json; waits are NOT_AVAILABLE for reliable per-query attribution.
